kind: owner-attended DV seek re-check with an owner-approved PID-scoped mapper probe
title_facts: source dv_profile 7 and dv_el_present true, from the overlay input user-data/cinema-video.source
owner_report: did a 30 second seek, which took forever, and it did the same thing as last time; did not get the fel pill back
mapper_returns: Every return in seconds 14-52 and 66-81 was 1 (mapped) with enhancement_layer_composed=1 and RPU present, 24 per full second in both sessions, including every full second 67-80 after re-creation. No 0 (unsupported) or -1 (error) returns, and no calls with the enhancement layer not composed.

conclusion: After the outside-session re-creation the provider kept composing the enhancement layer and mapping every frame. Only the player's renderer record, and with it the EL pill, was not restored. This directly confirms the cause that patch 0010 addresses, on the installed build.
separate_observation: About 14 s from the seek to the first new frame (52.9 to 66.9 s), which the owner described as taking forever. Not investigated here.
